metrics.alpha_precision: Upstream bgra64le uint16 -> yuva444p10le -> ProRes4444 decoded yuva444p12le -> RGBA16 storage. Effective alpha is bounded by upstream10bit quantization, not16bit accuracy. Prepared cache is RGB8 + linear alpha8.
metrics.note: Existing model run, no new inference. Prior full ProRes decode proof; cache creation time is not model processing time.

cases.roi_findings: Left flyaway hair and curled tips stay visible at the three selected poses; face-only central crops miss the hair boundary. Main directly opened the source/alpha/checker contact; for09/12/13 also the proposed detailed contact.

cases.color_convention: Preserve original PNG RGB code values and legacy FFmpeg-default decoded cutout display. Interpret those RGB values as sRGB for linear-light PAR correction; this is a display convention derived from Frame Dir Linear=False and Cutout Linear=False, not measured source primaries/transfer.
cases.source_metadata_caveat: PNG ancillary metadata is retained in the input snapshot; model image reader used cv2 RGB code values without ICC/gAMA conversion. In particular smoke has gAMA=1.0 but old model/review treated its code values with the sRGB display convention. This reuse preserves that convention rather than silently reinterpreting the old result.
